description: Composite table row action component that renders a single ghost button for one action, or a dropdown menu (DropdownMenu) for multiple actions. Supports icon, label, variant (including destructive), disabled state, and separator between items.
useCases: Table row with Edit and Delete actions collapsed into a kebab menu
Survey list row with a single primary action button (e.g., Open)
User management table with role-specific contextual actions per row
Data table with destructive delete action separated by a divider
